records.source: A new chick hatched... It looks odd.
records.translation: May bagong pisâ na sisiw... Kakaiba ang hitsura nito.

records.source: The submarine is currently in use. Come back later.
records.translation: Kasalukuyang ginagamit ang submarino. Bumalik mamaya.

records.source: Merchant: The night market starts at 5pm... visit me then for a free cup of coffee!
records.translation: Mangangalakal: Magsisimula ang Pamilihang-Gabi nang 5pm... balikan mo ako sa oras na iyon para sa libreng tasa ng kape!

records.source: Merchant: Hello there! Care for a cup of coffee?
records.translation: Mangangalakal: Kumusta! Gusto mo ba ng isang tasa ng kape?

records.source: Merchant: Mmm... smells great, doesn't it?
records.translation: Mangangalakal: Mmm... ang bango, hindi ba?

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: Come back when the market opens, if you wish to purchase my fine work.
records.translation: Sikat na Pintor na si Lupini: Bumalik kapag bukas na ang pamilihan kung nais mong bilhin ang mahusay kong likha.

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: I'm selling this painting for 1200g. What do you say?
records.translation: Sikat na Pintor na si Lupini: Ibinebenta ko ang obrang ito sa halagang 1200g. Ano sa palagay mo?

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: My apologies... I have no more paintings to sell today.
records.translation: Sikat na Pintor na si Lupini: Paumanhin... wala na akong obrang maibebenta ngayon.

records.source: Shrouded Figure: I can send you home for 250g.
records.translation: Nakabalabal na Nilalang: Maiuuwi kita sa halagang 250g.

records.source: Use 300 pieces of wood to fix the bridge?
records.translation: Gumamit ng 300 piraso ng kahoy upang kumpunihin ang tulay?

records.source: Hmmm... With 300 pieces of wood this could be fixed.
records.translation: Hmmm... Makukumpuni ito gamit ang 300 piraso ng kahoy.

records.source:
Gone fishing.

   I'll be back tomorrow.
Old Mariner: Glad the amulet worked out for ye, {0}.
records.translation: Matandang Marinero: Mabuti't umubra sa iyo ang agimat, {0}.

records.source: Old Mariner: Don't be shy, now. Show that amulet to the one you intend to marry.
records.translation: Matandang Marinero: Huwag ka nang mahiya. Ipakita mo ang agimat na iyan sa nais mong pakasalan.

records.source: Old Mariner: I can see that sparkle in yer eye, {0}. Ye must be head over heels in love. But I'm afraid a bigger house is essential for a happy marriage.
records.translation: Matandang Marinero: Nakikita ko ang kislap sa iyong mata, {0}. Tiyak na sinta mo siya nang lubos. Pero kailangan ang mas malaking bahay para sa masayang pagsasama.

records.source: Old Mariner: Ah, I can see it in yer eyes... There be a special someone in yer heart. Just so happens I'm sellin' a 'Mermaid's Pendant'. Give that to yer intended and they'll know exactly what you mean.
records.translation: Matandang Marinero: Ah, nakikita ko sa iyong mga mata... May natatangi kang iniibig. Nagkataong nagbebenta ako ng 'Palawit ng Sirena'. Ibigay mo ito sa nais mong pakasalan at mauunawaan niya ang ibig mong sabihin.

records.source: Old Mariner: I've got this old amulet to sell... but somethin' tells me yer not ready for it, {0}.
records.translation: Matandang Marinero: Mayroon akong lumang agimat na ibinebenta... pero may kutob akong hindi ka pa handa rito, {0}.
